pos.personaBrief: Tuchel's Chelsea averaged 75% possession early on (The Boar) and used possession as a defensive tool (CV profile), yet won the final by counters and Werner runs in behind (CV Real Madrid, final).

pro.personaBrief: Build-up was patient through the back three and double pivot (Spielverlagerung, CV final), with occasional long balls for Werner and quick plays to Pulisic after regains.

est.personaBrief: Tuchel wanted fluid formations; the front three rotated positions (CV final) and Havertz dropped deep, but phases had defined shapes (3-2-4-1 in attack, 5-2-3 without the ball).

lar.personaBrief: Wing-backs stayed high and wide (The Boar, CV final), stretched the pitch and crossed, while the double 10 occupied half-spaces.

blo.personaBrief: The team counter-pressed (Tuchel's West Ham quote), the front three pressed the centre-backs and a pressing trap pushed play wide, while the defence dropped into a back five when needed.

mar.personaBrief: Open-play defending was a compact back five covering space, but Tuchel stressed matching up physically at set pieces and Chelsea were later reported to man-mark them.

pla.personaBrief: Tuchel changed formation by match and opponent (Goal, Pride of London) and set up plans like drawing out Manchester United's press, but he imposed his own 3-4-2-1 on arrival.

res.personaBrief: The team was results-driven, with a very solid defence (clean sheets, 1-0 final) and game management late on, and no fixation on spectacle.

sis.personaBrief: System over stars: Tuchel rotated Ziyech, Werner and Havertz, chose players for the system (Jorginho quote), and asked everyone to defend.

jog.personaBrief: Technical, mobile players such as Jorginho, Kante, Havertz and Mount, with high work rate, and no room for a non-running number 10 (Ziyech was benched).

bas.personaBrief: Tuchel restored experienced players like Rudiger, Azpilicueta and Christensen (Pride of London) and picked mostly experienced line-ups (Goal), and he let Gilmour leave on loan.

lid.personaBrief: Tuchel stressed inclusion, transparency, bond and atmosphere (Goal, Jorginho), while taking sole responsibility for selection decisions.
